ModuleMeta.Name: Location Domain
ModuleMeta.Description: Geographic locations DDD domain: Countries with ISO alpha-2/3 codes and display names, States with country reference and abbreviation. Supports both admin CRUD and storefront queries with ISO code lookups.

Principle.name: ISO Standard Compliance
Principle.Description: Countries and states follow ISO 3166 standards for codes and abbreviations.
Principle.Rationale: Ensures interoperability with shipping, tax, and address validation systems.

Principle.name: Country as Aggregate Root
Principle.Description: Country is the aggregate root; states exist only within a country context.
Principle.Rationale: States have no independent existence outside their parent country.

Feature.name: Countries
Feature.Description: Country aggregate with ISO alpha-2/3 codes, display name, and associated states.

Feature.name: States
Feature.Description: State/province by country reference with abbreviation and ISO code.

Abstraction.name: Country
Abstraction.Description: Country aggregate with ISO alpha-2/3 codes and display name.
Abstraction.Purpose: Address validation, tax zone calculation, shipping zone definition.

Abstraction.name: State
Abstraction.Description: State/province by country reference with abbreviation and ISO code.
Abstraction.Purpose: Sub-national address component for shipping and tax.

AntiPattern.name: Free-Text Country
AntiPattern.Avoid: Using free-text strings for country references instead of CountryId foreign keys.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Use CountryId FK for data consistency and referential integrity.
